clue.text: Proudly show off row of shops

definitions.meaning: a short street or terrace of shops

explanation.surface: Someone flaunting themselves along a high street of shops.
explanation.definitionFit: Parading is flaunting in public, and in Britain a parade is also a terrace of shops.

clue.text: Mythical bird? It's found in Arizona

definitions.meaning: the legendary bird reborn from its own ashes

explanation.surface: Wondering whether a legendary bird lives in Arizona.
explanation.definitionFit: The phoenix is a fabled firebird, and Phoenix is also the capital city of Arizona.

clue.text: Capital lover and capital love

parts.note: Rome is the capital of Italy
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A first-rate suitor and a city's affection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital' in the definition means excellent; the second 'capital' is the city Rome.
explanation.definitionFit: A Romeo is a romantic, amorous man, named after Shakespeare's lover.

clue.text: Counting system with a point to it

definitions.text: Counting system with a point to it

parts.words: Counting system with a point to it
parts.note: the base-ten system uses a dot between whole numbers and fractions, and 'with a point' also suggests purpose

explanation.surface: A way of counting that actually serves some purpose.
explanation.definitionFit: The base-ten number system writes fractions after a point, so it literally has a point.

clue.text: Sponge ass's back — pleased expression

indicators.note: back here means the word for the ass is turned to run backwards

parts.note: an ass is a fool; the 's stands for 'is', so the ass is back
'ah!' is a sigh of satisfaction

explanation.surface: A donkey's rear end being washed down, to its evident pleasure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ass's back' reads as the donkey's rear, but it is FOOL with 's (is) back, giving LOOF.
explanation.definitionFit: A loofah is the dried fibrous gourd used as a bath scrubber, a natural sponge.

clue.text: Giraffes' cousins fine, needing a short wee

parts.note: OK means fine

indicators.note: short means the word for wee is cut by its last letter

parts.note: piss is a slang word for wee, urine

explanation.surface: Giraffe relatives doing fine, though in need of a quick pee.
explanation.definitionFit: The okapi of central Africa is the only living relative of the giraffe.

clue.text: Hot meal for this circus artiste?

definitions.text: Hot meal for this circus artiste?

parts.words: Hot meal for this circus artiste?
parts.note: a performer who swallows flames literally eats something hot

explanation.surface: Asking what warm dinner a circus performer would want.
explanation.definitionFit: A fire-eater is a performer who appears to swallow flames, a very hot meal indeed.

clue.text: Searched round area frequently visited

indicators.note: round means the word for searched goes around the letter for area

parts.note: hunted means searched

explanation.surface: A district combed over and over by searchers.
explanation.definitionFit: A haunt is a place often frequented, so haunted can mean visited habitually.

clue.text: Eminent inspector with poor suiting dropped

parts.note: DI is Detective Inspector

indicators.note: poor here means the letters of suiting are badly arranged

parts.note: shed means dropped, as leaves are shed

explanation.surface: A famous detective whose shabby suit has been abandoned.
explanation.definitionFit: Distinguished means renowned and highly respected, much as eminent does.

clue.text: To express disapproval of Mike leads to explosion

parts.note: to boo is to jeer in disapproval
Mike is the NATO alphabet word for M

explanation.surface: Jeering at a man called Mike sets off a blast of anger.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mike' looks like a person; it is the radio code word for M.
explanation.definitionFit: A boom is the deep sound of a blast, so stands for the blast itself.

clue.text: Greek character nothing short of brave and gallant

parts.note: chi is a letter of the Greek alphabet

indicators.note: short of means lacking, so the word for brave loses one letter

parts.note: valorous means brave
nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: A Greek who is nothing less than courageous and noble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nothing short of' looks like the idiom for 'utterly', but it says VALOROUS is short of an O.
explanation.definitionFit: Chivalrous and gallant both describe courteous, honourable conduct, especially towards women.

clue.text: Tell why one is playing well

explanation.surface: Explain what makes a performer play so well.
explanation.definitionFit: To inform is to pass on news; being in form means a player is at their best.

clue.text: Getting washed and dressed: after work, better to avoid extremes

indicators.note: after means the next piece follows the word for work

parts.note: toil is hard work

indicators.note: dropping the extremes keeps only the inner letters of better

explanation.surface: Advice that, after a day's labour, it is wise to do nothing excessive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to avoid extremes' looks like moderate advice but strips the first and last letters of 'better', leaving ETTE.
explanation.definitionFit: Toilette is the process of washing, dressing and grooming oneself.

clue.text: Doing really well with a spreadsheet?

definitions.text: Doing really well with a spreadsheet?

parts.words: Doing really well with a spreadsheet?
parts.note: Excel is a spreadsheet program

explanation.surface: Praise for someone's mastery of office spreadsheets.
explanation.definitionFit: Excelling means performing outstandingly, and the pun is on the Microsoft spreadsheet program.

clue.text: After short space nobleman and monarch meet

indicators.note: After means the nobleman and monarch follow the short space

parts.note: an en is a printer's space, half an em
a count is a European nobleman
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: A nobleman and a king meet after a brief gap.
explanation.walkthrough: An en is the typesetter's half-width space.
explanation.definitionFit: To encounter someone is to come upon or meet them.

clue.text: Read endlessly as boss

indicators.note: endlessly means the word for read loses its final letter

parts.note: to read a subject is to study it

explanation.surface: Studying without stopping, as one's boss demands.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boss' is not a manager: it is a stud, an ornamental knob.
explanation.definitionFit: A boss is a raised knob or stud, as on a shield or ceiling.

clue.text: Get rid of bed

explanation.surface: Throw out the bed.
explanation.definitionFit: Sacking is dismissing staff, and 'hit the sack' means go to bed.

clue.text: Painful experience after bathing?

parts.note: after sunbathing too long one gets burnt skin, the surface hinting at a dip in water

explanation.surface: Something that hurts after a swim.
explanation.definitionFit: Sunburn is skin reddened by too much sun, the price of sunbathing.

clue.text: Approve art house I rebuilt

indicators.note: rebuilt means these letters are put together in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone signing off on the renovation of an arts cinema.
explanation.definitionFit: To authorise is to sanction or give official permission.

clue.text: Spanish gentleman concealed goal stupidly

parts.note: hid means concealed

indicators.note: stupidly means the letters of goal are jumbled

explanation.surface: A Spanish nobleman foolishly hiding a goal.
explanation.definitionFit: A hidalgo is a member of the lower Spanish nobility.

clue.text: Something considered golden is shut up

explanation.surface: Something precious is locked away.
explanation.definitionFit: The saying runs 'speech is silver, silence is golden', and silencing a critic shuts them up.

clue.text: As if alternative company could be a complete disaster

indicators.note: alternative means another arrangement of the letters of as if

explanation.surface: A scornful remark that a rival firm could be a total flop.
explanation.definitionFit: A fiasco is a humiliating failure or total mess.

clue.text: In bodies a judge addresses damages

parts.note: a judge directs and speaks to the jury, so these bodies are juries

explanation.surface: A court hearing where the judge speaks to juries about compensation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'damages' suggests court compensation but is a plural noun meaning harm done.
explanation.definitionFit: Injuries are harm or hurt suffered, which damages also means as a plural noun.

clue.text: Waddle half back, and don't hurry

indicators.note: half back means the first half of waddle is turned to run backwards

explanation.surface: A duck waddling back slowly, unhurried.
explanation.walkthrough: Only the first three letters WAD turn round, becoming DAW, while DLE stays put.
explanation.definitionFit: To dawdle is to linger or move slowly, the opposite of hurrying.

clue.text: Poorest quality terrace put up on street

indicators.note: on means the first piece sits above the street in this down entry
put up in a down entry means the word for terrace is written upwards

parts.note: a terrace of houses is a row

explanation.surface: Shoddy housing built along a street.
explanation.definitionFit: Worst means of the lowest standard, the poorest in quality.

clue.text: Less than a storm at sea? That's lucky

definitions.text: Less than a storm at sea?
definitions.meaning: a sea that is ..., mere rolling waves, is less than a storm
'...' says a thing turned out fortunately

explanation.surface: Sailors relieved that the weather is only rough, not a gale.
explanation.definitionFit: 'Just as well' is an idiom for fortunately; a swell is a heavy rolling of the sea.

clue.text: Called up to manage golf

parts.note: to run a business is to manage it
Golf is G in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Someone drafted in to run a golf club.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Called up' suggests conscription but means telephoned, rung in British usage.
explanation.definitionFit: To ring someone is to phone them, so rung means called up.

clue.text: New weapon is limited

parts.note: an arrow is a weapon shot from a bow

explanation.surface: A new weapon whose use is restricted.
explanation.definitionFit: Narrow means restricted in scope, as in a narrow range.

clue.text: Resolve to belt criminal

indicators.note: criminal means the letters are treated wrongly, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A villain's determination to thump someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Bottle is British slang for courage or nerve, which resolve also means.
